question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in hybrid BM25 plus vector retrieval, or should this remain an external ClawHub/plugin direction?
rationale: The code change is feasible inside the plugin, but it changes ranking semantics, adds config/default surface, creates persistent FTS index behavior, and overlaps with external plugin/reranker directions.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub/external plugin
options.body: Close this repo item only after maintainers decide the existing or new external LanceDB plugin should own advanced hybrid/rerank features.

options.title: Keep memory-lancedb vector-only
options.body: Document that memory-lancedb remains a vector backend while memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval, avoiding a new config and indexing surface.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb history and prior maintainer-side review context on this issue.
